AbsoluteLimits.description: The outer cap the pilot may raise limits to, plus the largest search area (read-only).
AbsoluteLimits.title: AbsoluteLimits

ActionRequest.description: Body of STOP, FLY HOME, Resume and Take over / Hand back.
ActionRequest.title: ActionRequest

Attitude.description:
MAVLink ATTITUDE in degrees. Roll is positive right wing down, pitch positive nose
up, yaw 0-360 clockwise from north.
Attitude.title: Attitude

AutonomyMode.description: Set only by the operator on the charter card; the AI can never change it.
AutonomyMode.title: AutonomyMode

CandidateCard.description: One candidate as the panel's queue shows it.
CandidateCard.title: CandidateCard

CandidateDecision.description: A person's decision on a candidate. Only a logged-in person's session may send it.
CandidateDecision.title: CandidateDecision

CandidateView.description:
A detection's picture in large size, logged for the session that asked for it (a
confirmation needs one). The JPEG is at ``GET /api/v1/views/{view_id}``.
CandidateView.title: CandidateView

CharterProposal.description:
A new or changed charter from the pilot (panel) or the AI.

It has no field for the autonomy mode, the mission's SafetyLimits, home or the pilot
position: sending one is rejected (unknown fields are forbidden). Its own charter
values are checked against the mission limits by the server before any card shows.
CharterProposal.title: CharterProposal

CloudBudgetStatus.description:
What the panel shows: spent and caps for the mission (when one is given) and the
day (Swedish date). ``exhausted``: no cloud calls; ``warning`` from 80 %.
CloudBudgetStatus.title: CloudBudgetStatus

DetectionRow.description:
A stored detection (``GET /missions/{id}/detections``). A hint, never a decision.
``source = "oracle"`` is the simulator's own label, not a detector.
DetectionRow.title: DetectionRow

Find.description:
One found object: detections of one class at the same place, joined
(``GET /missions/{id}/finds``, live ``find.new`` / ``find.updated``). Not confirmed:
only a person confirms.
Find.title: Find

LastSeen.description: The initial planning point (IPP): where and when the person was last seen.
LastSeen.title: LastSeen

LinkLossPhase.description:
Where the onboard link-loss rule is (sd_onboard.executor.link_loss).

Times count from the last inbound SD-link message.
LinkLossPhase.title: LinkLossPhase

LinkLossPlan.description:
What the ground expects the onboard link-loss rule to do while SD-link is down: the
same ``sd_safety.link_loss.choose_mode`` on the last snapshot and keep-out list. The
panel counts down to these times; the flight controller's real mode (over MAVLink,
when it is up) wins where they differ.
LinkLossPlan.title: LinkLossPlan

ManualControlState.description: Whether the pilot is steering by hand (Ta över) and since when.
ManualControlState.title: ManualControlState

MapImagery.description: An aerial photo pack (raster PMTiles) drawn under the map's roads, paths and names.
MapImagery.title: MapImagery

MissionBudgetCap.description: The pilot raises (or lowers) the mission's cap, never above the outer cap.
MissionBudgetCap.title: MissionBudgetCap

MissionCharter.description: An approved (or proposed) charter. Fields marked *server* are set by the ground station.
MissionCharter.title: MissionCharter

OperatorCommandRequest.description: An order from the pilot, e.g. an order button. Same gate and latch as the AI's orders.
OperatorCommandRequest.title: OperatorCommandRequest

OperatorLatch.description: Set by STOP, FLY HOME, the battery guard or the watchdog. Only Resume lifts it.
OperatorLatch.title: OperatorLatch

ProbabilityMapView.description:
The panel's view of the latest version. ``p_b64`` and ``pod_b64`` are base64 of
little-endian float16 arrays (row-major, row 0 the southernmost).
ProbabilityMapView.title: ProbabilityMapView

SafetyLimits.description: Per-mission limits (outer layer). Heights are metres above the home point.
SafetyLimits.title: SafetyLimits

SearchProfile.description:
What the person looked like, as the operator approved it.

A proposal from the AI has ``approved_by = None`` and is never used for matching.
SearchProfile.title: SearchProfile

SearchProfileApproval.description:
The pilot's approval from the card: the profile as corrected, and what the card
showed when they began. A newer version or proposal than that is refused (409), so an
approval never covers AI content the pilot has not seen.
SearchProfileApproval.title: SearchProfileApproval

SearchProfileDraft.description:
A search profile before the ground station numbers and stores it: what the AI
proposes from the chat, and what the pilot's card sends when they approve.

The ground station sets the mission, the profile id, the version and who approved
it. The age and height bands, the place last seen and the sources are for the people
searching, never for the cloud matching.
SearchProfileDraft.title: SearchProfileDraft

SearchProfileState.description: The profile in force (highest approved version) and a newer proposal, if any.
SearchProfileState.title: SearchProfileState

SectorScore.description:
One sector of the charter on the current map.

``poa``: the chance the person is in the sector now (cells whose centre lies in it).
``covered_pct``: the share of its cells seen with a POD of at least 0.1.
``mean_pod``: the mean cumulative POD over its cells.
``pos_plan``: the chance of finding the person if the sector is surveyed once more as
planned. ``psr``: ``pos_plan`` per minute of planned flight (higher first).
SectorScore.title: SectorScore

StateRef.description: Which state picture an order was based on (onboard StateSnapshot epoch and sequence).
StateRef.title: StateRef

StateSnapshot.description: Onboard -> ground, 2 Hz, not reliable. What only the onboard computer knows.
StateSnapshot.title: StateSnapshot

Telemetry.description: From the ground station's own MAVLink channel.
Telemetry.title: Telemetry

WindCheck.description:
The ground station's "too windy" warning. ``TILT_MARGIN`` and ``WIND_LIMIT`` are
warnings only. ``ENERGY_HOME`` warns on the strictest estimate, and starts the ground
station's battery FLY HOME (``battery_rtl``) only when the estimate with the flight
controller's own numbers is short, or the wind estimate is short with a measured drag;
that can only make the flight home earlier. Its thresholds are not yet calibrated
against flight logs, so ``calibrated`` is always false for now.

* ``TILT_MARGIN``: the mean tilt over the last 10 s in the air is within 10 degrees of
  the flight controller's lean limit (ATC_ANGLE_MAX, read from the flight controller).
* ``ENERGY_HOME``: flying home now would leave less than the flight controller's
  low-battery reserve, or the wind is too strong to get home at all. The strictest of
  the estimate at RTL speed and the measured current with a 30 % margin (with the
  constants and with the flight controller's BATT_CAPACITY, BATT_LOW_MAH and
  RTL_SPEED_MS), and (with WIND) the same against the measured headwind and crosswind
  on the way home. Too strong to get home only warns.
* ``WIND_LIMIT``: the flight controller's own wind estimate (MAVLink WIND; the EKF
  estimates wind only with drag fusion, EK3_DRAG_*) is over the configured wind limit.
WindCheck.title: WindCheck

post.description:
Only a pilot's click approves a charter or an order (never the AI, never a script
outside the test rig).

get.description:
One candidate: its card, the detections it observed, every assessment and every
person's decision.

post.description:
Only a person in the panel decides (never the AI, the search service or a script
outside the test rig). Observers confirm, reject and mark unsure; inspect and reopen
are the pilot's. Confirming needs a large view from the same session first (409
``NOT_VIEWED``); a card older than the candidate is 409 ``SUPERSEDED``.

get.description: A confirmed find as a GPX 1.1 waypoint for the ground team.

Spent and caps today and for the mission (the latest one with a call, unless one
is named).

post.description:
Open a detection's picture in large size. The server logs it for the session: a
confirmation needs it. The picture is at ``GET /api/v1/views/{view_id}`` and is never
sent to the cloud.

schema.title: Response Get Missions Api V1 Missions Get
Response Get Annotations Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Annotations Get
Response Get Approvals Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Approvals Get

get.description:
The review queue: candidates by priority, highest first. Every candidate is
listed (a low priority only puts it further down); merged ones only with
``state=merged``. ``counts``: to review (priority >= 0.30), low, confirmed, rejected.
Paging: ``before_seq`` = the ``seq`` of the previous page's last card; the next page
holds the cards after it in queue order (not "seq lower than").

schema.title: Response Get Charters Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Charters Get
Response Get Chat Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Chat Get

post.description:
A pilot's exact "stopp", "stop" or "flyg hem" acts like the button, before the
line is stored and without the AI. "Fortsätt" never releases a stop. With the
database down the words still act (on every vehicle); the line is then not stored.
"Fritt runt drönaren": its origin is the listener that took the click.

put.description: The pilot sets the mission's cap (at most the outer cap). Logged.

schema.title: Response Get Commands Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Commands Get

post.description: An order button: the same gate and latch as the AI's orders.

get.description:
The mission's detections, newest first (at most 2000). ``source = "oracle"`` marks
the simulator's own labels, never a real detector.

schema.title: Response Get Detections Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Detections Get

get.description: A target detection's thumbnail (JPEG), only from inside the mission's folder.

schema.title: Response Get Events Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Events Get
Response Get Files Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Files Get

get.description: Only files recorded for the mission, only inside its folder.
One entry per found object: detections of a class at the same place, joined.

schema.title: Response Get Finds Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Finds Get
Response Get Gate Decisions Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Gate Decisions Get

put.description: Stricter, or raised by click up to the outer cap (``config/local/limits.toml``).

get.description:
The newest version of the probability map, ``null`` before the first (like the
search profile: no map yet is a state, not an error). ``p_b64`` and ``pod_b64``:
base64 float16, row-major, row 0 the southernmost.

schema.title: Response Get Probability Map Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Probability Map Get

get.description:
The map as an image, one pixel per cell, north up: ``poa`` transparent to red,
``pod`` transparent to blue. ``Sd-Bounds``: west,south,east,north.
The approved profile in force and a newer proposal from the AI, if any.

post.description:
Approve profile: only a pilot's click in the panel. The profile as sent becomes the
next version; 409 when a newer version or proposal arrived since the card showed it.

schema.title: Response Get Search Profile Versions Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Search Profile Versions Get
Response Get Sectors Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Sectors Get

get.description:
Each sector on the newest map: POA left, share covered, mean POD and PSR, in the
suggested order (highest PSR first). Empty before the first map.

schema.title: Response Get Sector Poa Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Sectors Poa Get
Response Get Track Api V1 Missions  Mission Id  Track Get
Response Get Vehicles Api V1 Vehicles Get

post.description: The pilot's Resume: lifts the latch and tells the onboard computer. Never MAVLink.
Every logged-in user may press STOP (observers too); RETURN HOME is for the pilot.
Ta över: LOITER, the AI's orders pause, the sticks go from the ground station.

get.description: The picture of a logged large view (JPEG).
A map pack (HTTP Range supported), a glyph range or a sprite file.
